title: Version 1.57.0
body:
Version 1.57.0 (🎉 15 MILLION VISITS!)

June 6th, 2024

Added:

  • The classic Tree, Cacti, and Ore are here for 2 weeks!
  • The following content is permanent and here to stay:
  • Added a bunch of new classic tools to the classic store: the Subspace Tripmine, Trowel, and Slingshot! These can randomly be found in the store, depending on the rotation
  • A new capture the flag structure has been added, found at the classic store! This is constantly in the rotation
  • A classic joop is now obtainable in the classic store! This has a random chance of being in the store's rotation
  • A baby ducky and classic moai are added to the classic store as well. The ducky is constantly in rotation

Changes:

  • The classic store now has more purchasable spawns, and only a max of one item per type can spawn
  • Clover trees are now 4x more rare to find

Version 1.57.1

June 6th, 2024

Changes:

  • Players can now only have up to 25 vehicles spawned at once
  • A notice now appears when you try to pick up a tool and your inventory is full

Fixed:

  • Fixed not being able to reset flag scores

Version 1.57.2

June 6th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Apologies for the issue of not being able to toggle vehicle headlights, I can't push a live fix for this unfortunately.

Version 1.57.3

June 7th, 2024

Changed:

  • Slots that are from newer servers with major updates can no longer be loaded into older servers
  • The summary changelog will now show all the versions up until the major update!
  • Removed collision on the Classic Joop's exhaust pipe

Fixed:

  • Fixed Slingshots not being able to do damage to others, and not being able to take damage
